payload.author: claude
payload.body: Verified blob metadata + derivative stores on PgSqlDriver (2/2 on PG16). Fix: blob_metadata + blob_derivatives INSERT OR REPLACE -> ON CONFLICT(pk) DO UPDATE (portable); BYTEA round-trips. Blob bytes stay the sync BlobBytesDriver seam (SQLite/filesystem) — PG uses filesystem bytes; a PG-native BYTEA bytes driver needs an async bytes interface (FR-9). SQLite blobs 32 green. Completes per-store-family slices FR-119-122.
